[10Related Set Effects](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Healing#Related_Set_Effects) ## Description | | | | --- | --- | | [![Healing.png](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/f/f3/Healing.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Healing.png) | Healing magic replenishes HP by using mana which is the fundamental force that makes up this world. Healing magic recovers a certain amount of HP in the target, and this helps recover the target's energy which was lost due to heavy adventuring. In addition, the power of this magic is strong enough to affect the target as well as the caster. The caster who has finished preparing to cast this magic is protected from external attacks by the power of magic. This effectiveness and the experience points from this magic increases when your life is low, so proper timing would be helpful. But you must remember this one thing - that the magic only recovers HP, it cannot treat wounds. | ## Details - Healing allows one to restore [HP](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/HP "HP") to oneself or to a friendly unit. - Healing automatically charges 5 stacks when used. - Healing charges are expended one at a time. - Using Healing on oneself drains the user's [Stamina](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stamina "Stamina") equal to the HP healed. - No stamina is lost if no health is recovered. - Healing has a chance to critically heal for additional healing. - Each stack charged will raise the user's [Defense](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Defense_(Stat) "Defense (Stat)"). - The first three charges add +4 Defense, the 4th charge adds +3, and the last charge adds +5. - Healing cannot target enemies, users or pets engaged in [duels](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/PvP "PvP"), or arena opponents. - It is possible to heal [NPCs](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Category:NPCs "Category:NPCs"); this is useful in some [Shadow Missions](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Shadow_Mission "Shadow Mission") and [Theatre Missions](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Theatre_Mission "Theatre Mission") which require players to keep NPCs alive. - NPCs must be manually clicked as Ctrl does not automatically snap to them. - It is not possible to heal [Summoned Golems](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Summon_Golem "Summon Golem"), [Pierrot Marionettes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Pierrot_Marionette "Pierrot Marionette"), or [Colossus Marionettes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Colossus_Marionette "Colossus Marionette"). - Healing recovers [Wounds](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stats#Wounds "Stats") starting at Rank Dan 1. - Additionally, equipping a Title such as [the Master of Party Healing](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/index.php?title=The_Master_of_Party_Healing&action=edit&redlink=1 "The Master of Party Healing (page does not exist)") can allow you to remedy Wounds (in this example, 10% of the amount healed) while using both Healing and Party Healing. - [Healing Wands](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Healing_Wand "Healing Wand") restore an additional 5 HP per charge. - Healing with [Classic Spirit Wands](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Classic_Spirit_Weapons "Classic Spirit Weapons") will increase the effectiveness of Healing. - All charges of Healing are lost when the caster is knocked back/down. At Rank 1, the caster loses one charge. - Higher ranks do not necessarily increase the skill's Mana efficiency; several ranks cause the spell to become less efficient than the previous rank. See the summary chart. - Note: This does not take into account the Critical Healing Rate. - Healing cast by a Link 6 [Harmonic Saint](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Harmonic_Saint "Harmonic Saint") will apply the [![Effect - Wings Heart Plus PB.png](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/8/86/Effect_-_Wings_Heart_Plus_PB.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Effect_-_Wings_Heart_Plus_PB.png)[Warmth of Life](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Warmth_of_Life "Warmth of Life") Status Effect to the caster. - Each individual charge will apply 1 stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks total. - This Status Effect will empower the user's [Hand of Restoration](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Hand_of_Restoration "Hand of Restoration") and [Echoes of Salvation](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Echoes_of_Salvation "Echoes of Salvation") Skills for 1 minute, with each stack of the effect increasing their healing effect by 7% and adding 200 Wound recovery. - Read the book _[Healing: The Basics of Magic](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Healing:_The_Basics_of_Magic "Healing: The Basics of Magic")_. It can be purchased for 9,800 gold from [Lassar](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Lassar "Lassar"), [Stewart](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stewart "Stewart"), [Aeira](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Aeira "Aeira"), [Berched](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Berched "Berched"), [Heulfryn](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Heulfryn "Heulfryn"), [Kirine](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Kirine "Kirine"), and [Finola](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Finola "Finola"). or, - Complete the quest [The Basics of Holy Arts](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Beginner_Talent_Quests#The_Basics_of_Holy_Arts "Beginner Talent Quests"). - This quest can be obtained by rebirthing into the Holy Arts Talent. ## Skill Issues - Healing may drain Stamina if the user's HP is full when self-healing. The cause of this caused by stat bonuses from titles, talents, and HP buffs. It is only temporary and will go away after some time. - Healing in rapid succession may cause training to be skipped. - Healing HP to full does not count for the "Use Healing" requirement. - It is possible to heal normally hostile enemies when the player uses the Healing skill during a duel with another player. ## Training Method - The skill **must** recover HP to receive skill training (full HP as well as wounding does not count). - Being under 20% of Max HP is considered 'in distress'. - This includes [Deadly](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Deadly_(Status) "Deadly (Status)") status. ### Training Tips #### Best Method - One can attack barrier spikes in Shadow Mission [Tense Escape](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tense_Escape "Tense Escape") in [Iria: Episode 7 - Heroic Path: The Choice](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Iria:_Episode_7_-_Heroic_Path:_The_Choice "Iria: Episode 7 - Heroic Path: The Choice"). These barrier spikes will return damage back. - [Rag Dolls](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Rag_Dolls_List "Rag Dolls List") will also take damage, allowing up to 4 rag dolls that can be easily healed by using self-targeted [Party Healing](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Party_Healing "Party Healing"). The rag dolls will quickly enter a "state of distress" by damaging themselves on the spikes. - This method requires you to be in a party by yourself before entering Tense Escape. - You must manually click on them or yourself, targeting will not work here. - You can also heal your pet if your pet attacks the spikes, adding one more target. #### Other Methods - One can find a [Dark Knight](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dark_Knight "Dark Knight") willing to transform near a [Mana Tunnel](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Mana_Tunnel "Mana Tunnel") in [Iria](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Iria "Iria"). The tunnel will continuously provide [MP](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/MP "MP"), allowing the healer to cast the spell endlessly once the transformed player enters their [Disarm](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stats#Status_Effects "Stats") state and begins rapidly losing HP. It may be difficult to keep up with the HP drain at lower skill ranks, but eventually a healer should be able to easily surpass the drain effect. - If possible, using [Party Healing](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Party_Healing "Party Healing") on a party of 8 Dark Knights in such an area will allow Healing to train faster, as it counts for each person (including pets). - It would be wise to carry [MP Potions](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Potion "Potion"), a high rank [Meditation](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Meditation "Meditation"), or a fully upgraded [Tikka Wood Healing Wand](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tikka_Wood_Healing_Wand "Tikka Wood Healing Wand") for the following methods below, as Healing uses high amounts of MP. - If it has not been taken out the current day, a player can touch the [Sword of Elsinore](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Sword_of_Elsinore "Sword of Elsinore") located on the west side of [Avon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Avon "Avon") to damage themselves until they are in [deadly](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Deadly_(Status) "Deadly (Status)"), although this method is time-consuming. - Early-game players can use the [Sulfur Pits](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Sulfur_Pits "Sulfur Pits") of [Zardine](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Zardine "Zardine"). Later-game players can use the [Decaying Swamp](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Decaying_Swamp "Decaying Swamp") as a dangerous option. - The recoil effect from [Respite](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Respite "Respite")'s reaction to magic, using [Dorcha Conversion](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dorcha_Conversion "Dorcha Conversion") (Paired with [Time Shift](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Time_Shift "Time Shift")), or loading [Urgent Shot](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Urgent_Shot "Urgent Shot") (at the cost of a lot of Stamina and HP each time) are other possible means to bring down a player's HP quickly. ### Novice Rank - metadata.ogDescription: Healing magic replenishes HP by using mana which is the fundamental force that makes up this world. Healing magic recovers a certain amount of HP in the target, and this helps recover the target's energy which was lost due to heavy adventuring. In addition, the power of this magic is strong enough to affect the target as well as the caster. Description

 Healing magic replenishes HP by using mana which is the fundamental force that makes up this world. Healing magic recovers a certain amount of HP in the target, and this helps recover the target's energy which was lost due to heavy adventuring. In addition, the power of this magic is strong enough to affect the target as well as the caster. The caster who has finished preparing to cast this magic is protected from external attacks by the power of magic. This effectiveness and the experience points from this magic increases when your life is low, so proper timing would be helpful. But you must remember this one thing - that the magic only recovers HP, it cannot treat wounds.

Details

  • Healing allows one to restore HP to oneself or to a friendly unit.
  • Healing automatically charges 5 stacks when used.
    • Healing charges are expended one at a time.
  • Using Healing on oneself drains the user's Stamina equal to the HP healed.
    • No stamina is lost if no health is recovered.
  • Healing has a chance to critically heal for additional healing.
  • Each stack charged will raise the user's Defense.
    • The first three charges add +4 Defense, the 4th charge adds +3, and the last charge adds +5.
  • Healing cannot target enemies, users or pets engaged in duels, or arena opponents.
  • It is possible to heal NPCs; this is useful in some Shadow Missions and Theatre Missions which require players to keep NPCs alive.
    • NPCs must be manually clicked as Ctrl does not automatically snap to them.
  • It is not possible to heal Summoned Golems, Pierrot Marionettes, or Colossus Marionettes.
  • Healing recovers Wounds starting at Rank Dan 1.
    • Additionally, equipping a Title such as the Master of Party Healing can allow you to remedy Wounds (in this example, 10% of the amount healed) while using both Healing and Party Healing.
  • Healing Wands restore an additional 5 HP per charge.
  • Healing with Classic Spirit Wands will increase the effectiveness of Healing.
  • All charges of Healing are lost when the caster is knocked back/down. At Rank 1, the caster loses one charge.
  • Higher ranks do not necessarily increase the skill's Mana efficiency; several ranks cause the spell to become less efficient than the previous rank. See the summary chart.
    • Note: This does not take into account the Critical Healing Rate.
  • Healing cast by a Link 6 Harmonic Saint will apply the Warmth of Life Status Effect to the caster.
    • Each individual charge will apply 1 stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks total.
    • This Status Effect will empower the user's Hand of Restoration and Echoes of Salvation Skills for 1 minute, with each stack of the effect increasing their healing effect by 7% and adding 200 Wound recovery.
      • Using Healing again will refresh the duration.

Obtaining the Skill

  • Read the book Healing: The Basics of Magic. It can be purchased for 9,800 gold from Lassar, Stewart, Aeira, Berched, Heulfryn, Kirine, and Finola.

or,

  • Complete the quest The Basics of Holy Arts.
    • This quest can be obtained by rebirthing into the Holy Arts Talent.

Skill Issues

  • Healing may drain Stamina if the user's HP is full when self-healing. The cause of this caused by stat bonuses from titles, talents, and HP buffs. It is only temporary and will go away after some time.
  • Healing in rapid succession may cause training to be skipped.
  • Healing HP to full does not count for the "Use Healing" requirement.
  • It is possible to heal normally hostile enemies when the player uses the Healing skill during a duel with another player.

Training Method

  • The skill must recover HP to receive skill training (full HP as well as wounding does not count).
  • Being under 20% of Max HP is considered 'in distress'.
    • This includes Deadly status.

Training Tips

Best Method

  • One can attack barrier spikes in Shadow Mission Tense Escape in Iria: Episode 7 - Heroic Path: The Choice. These barrier spikes will return damage back.
    • Rag Dolls will also take damage, allowing up to 4 rag dolls that can be easily healed by using self-targeted Party Healing. The rag dolls will quickly enter a "state of distress" by damaging themselves on the spikes.
      • This method requires you to be in a party by yourself before entering Tense Escape.
      • You must manually click on them or yourself, targeting will not work here.
      • You can also heal your pet if your pet attacks the spikes, adding one more target.

Other Methods

  • One can find a Dark Knight willing to transform near a Mana Tunnel in Iria. The tunnel will continuously provide MP, allowing the healer to cast the spell endlessly once the transformed player enters their Disarm state and begins rapidly losing HP. It may be difficult to keep up with the HP drain at lower skill ranks, but eventually a healer should be able to easily surpass the drain effect.
    • If possible, using Party Healing on a party of 8 Dark Knights in such an area will allow Healing to train faster, as it counts for each person (including pets).
  • It would be wise to carry MP Potions, a high rank Meditation, or a fully upgraded Tikka Wood Healing Wand for the following methods below, as Healing uses high amounts of MP.
  • If it has not been taken out the current day, a player can touch the Sword of Elsinore located on the west side of Avon to damage themselves until they are in deadly, although this method is time-consuming.
  • Early-game players can use the Sulfur Pits of Zardine. Later-game players can use the Decaying Swamp as a dangerous option.
  • The recoil effect from Respite's reaction to magic, using Dorcha Conversion (Paired with Time Shift), or loading Urgent Shot (at the cost of a lot of Stamina and HP each time) are other possible means to bring down a player's HP quickly.
